// @path: src/app/ops/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-SAME-ORIGIN-FETCH
// The same-origin rule matched only a URL beginning with a literal slash, so a
// template literal read child data through the front door and passed. Ops has
// no legitimate outbound call: R19 requires the health pane to render the
// internal result rather than fetch the public endpoint.
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";

export default async function OpsHome() {
  await requireOperator();
  const r = await fetch(`${process.env.APP_URL}/api/drafts`);
  return <main>{(await r.json()).length}</main>;
}
